messages:
maria_finance: Heads-up — AWS Marketplace invoice for Mar is short by ~ $18.4k for the reseller channel. Looks like usage lines for partner account 987654321 are missing from the marketplace export. Anyone seen this? attaching the small extract I pulled from the billing CSV.

maria_finance: ```
invoice_id,partner_account_id,usage_amount,reseller_account_id
inv-20260301,987654321,18420,
```

liam_revops: :eyes: I can help investigate. Last month we had a similar gap when AWS consolidated partner lines under the master account. @nina_billing can you confirm if our parser dropped the reseller field?

nina_billing: On it. Pulling the raw feed now. Quick initial note: AWS deployed a change 2026-03-01 that made `reseller_account_id` optional in certain consolidated reports — our ingest assumed it always existed. Will run a fallback parse.

jordan_ops: If the field is optional, our lambda probably throws away the line. @nina_billing, can you paste the S3 key for the failing file or a small sample?

nina_billing: S3 key: s3://redwood-billing/aws/2026/03/01/part-0003.csv
nina_billing: sample row from raw file (verbatim):
```
inv-20260301,987654321,18420,
```

aws-billing-bot: AWS Marketplace notice: schema v2 rollout completed 2026-03-01 — "reseller_account_id" may be omitted for consolidated partner reports. See https://aws.example/marketplace/announcements (automated).

sam_sales: This will impact PartnerEdge payouts and our forecast. Do we need to issue manual credits to affected partners or will this be an adjustment on the next invoice?

nina_billing: Preliminary delta ~ $18,420. Plan: 1) re-run ingest with schema fallback to reattribute lines to partner 987654321; 2) if reingest can’t retroactively push to AWS invoice, we'll issue manual credits. Recommend issuing a manual credit this week to avoid partner churn. Need approval from RevOps for credit amount.

liam_revops: I approve manual credits up to $20k for this reseller. Please record approval in finance-approvals doc and include the partner contact thread. :+1:

maria_finance: Thanks. @nina_billing please create a JIRA and tag #finance. I’ll draft the credit memo and get sign-off from legal. Also cc sales for partner comms.

nina_billing: Created JIRA INF-4127 and a PR for parser fallback. Scheduled reingest for 2026-03-24 04:00 UTC. I’ll post results here once reattrib/adjust runs complete.

maria_finance: Great — keep us posted. If reingest shows >$20k we’ll escalate to finance leadership for emergency approval.
